# Cully v0.32.0

Adds `cully ui`, a browser UI for running and managing coding agents, and the pages that go with it.

- **Run agents from the browser.** Give Cully a task: it gathers context from the project journal, can recall memory and scout the web, then starts a Claude agent in its own git worktree on the next OAuth token from your tokens file. You chat with it while it works, see its diff, comment on diff lines, and hand its work to another agent. A board shows every agent, flags two agents editing the same file, and holds a queue of tasks for when a slot is free. Agents can be started in any writable folder you choose.
- **Keep going until checked.** An optional loop makes sure the agent ran tests after changing files, steers it when it repeats a call, and judges its work against "done when" lines you write. It stops after a set number of rounds or tool calls.
- **Every session, named and scored.** The Sessions page lists what is open now and recent sessions with Resume and Fork for Claude. The session library counts time worked, tool calls, files changed and test runs from each transcript, and, once you turn naming on, writes a title, description and what could go better for each session. Session health scores sessions and flags loops, repeated failures and untested changes. Completed sessions become eval cases you can run, and a workflow coach suggests jobs, skills, MCP servers and habits from the patterns it sees.
- **Advisor and scout.** Advice and scout results are kept on disk and shown as a history. An optional hourly scout lets the advisor pick a general technical search from what you have been working on; it refuses any search that names a folder, path, link or ticket.
- **Controls.** An Agent permissions page sets which tools headless agents may use. A bell turns on notifications. Agent replies render as Markdown with tables and code blocks.

It listens on 127.0.0.1 by default and always needs a login token. Nothing from your conversations is stored in the session library. Saving the library to the Cully MCP is not part of this release; everything is kept in files in your Cully folder.

Update with `cully update`, then run `cully ui`.
